note: Fresh acceptance set B. Written and frozen (with image SHA-256 in FROZEN-B.txt) BEFORE any model run on these images. Integration check, NOT a benchmark: 6 synthetic cases, no accuracy claim. 'outcome' = deterministic rules on the on-device reading as returned and cleaned by the checks, with the reviewer confirming WITHOUT editing (acknowledging any flagged problem) = worst case. 'productOutcome' = what the app shows before the reviewer acknowledges flagged problems. Rules must not be changed to fit these cases; failures are reported as failures.

cases.why: The rules cannot catch a wrong reading by themselves (they would clear it). PASS for the app = the comparison with the verified record LBL-1003@1 surfaces both invented changes for the reviewer to check against the image, and the reviewer's correction to what the image shows gives PRINT_BLOCKED. Whether a human reviewer actually catches it is a separate, human test (not done by the AI that wrote the case).
